## 📅 Course Roadmap & Calendar (Fall 2025)

*Lectures: Fridays 11:00–13:00 in HLB108 · Tutorials: Fridays 13:00–14:00 in HLB108*  
*Assignment Deadlines (A1–A4) are at 11:00 AM on specified Fridays.*

| Date | Event | Core Topics & Compilers | Deadlines & Milestones |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **11 Sep** | L1, T1 | Scope of HPC; History of Scientific Computing & Architecture | |
| **18 Sep** | L2z | Linux CLI (CentOS/Rocky), Shells (bash/tcsh), Editors | Synchronous online (Zoom) |
| **25 Sep** | L3, T2 | Connectivity (ssh/sftp); Compilers (gcc, gfortran, ifort, nvcc) | Python vs C/F95 Benchmarks |
| **02 Oct** | L4, T3 | C & Fortran 95 Syntax; 711 Puzzle; Calling C from Python | **Assignment #1 Due (11:00 AM)** |
| **09 Oct** | L5, T4 | Monte Carlo Methods; OpenMP Fork-Join Parallelism on CPU | |
| **16 Oct** | L6, T5 | Microprocessor Limits, Multicore Scaling & Moore's Law | **Assignment #2 Due** (Form A4 Groups) |
| **23 Oct** | L7, T6 | Many Integrated Cores (MIC / Xeon Phi); UTSC Clusters | **In-Class Midterm (11:10–12:10)** |
| **30 Oct** | -- | *Reading Week (No Classes or Tutorials)* | Study Break |
| **06 Nov** | L8, T7 | OpenMP in C & Fortran; RAM Bandwidth Bottlenecks; DISLIN | SPH Fluid Dynamics Intro |
| **13 Nov** | L9, T8 | CPU vs MIC vs GPU; N-body Solvers; Inverted Broomstick AI | |
| **20 Nov** | L10 | Fluid Dynamics (Eulerian vs Lagrangian); FFT Gravitational Solvers | **Assignment #3 Due (11:00 AM)** |
| **27 Nov** | L11, T9 | GPU Computing in CUDA C/Fortran; Introduction to MPI | Optimization & Neural Nets |
| **04 Dec** | L12, T10 | Capstone Presentation of A4 Group Projects | **Assignment #4 Project Due** |
| **Dec Period** | Final* | **Comprehensive Final Examination** (3 Hours: Theory + Coding) | Scheduled by Registrar |

::: {.callout-note}
### Course Schedule & Grading Notes
Course grading: Assignments A1–A3 (21%), Group Project A4 (23%), Midterm Exam (16%), Final Exam (40%). Detailed policies on cluster usage (`art-1`, `art-2`), late submissions, and academic integrity are in the official course syllabus on Quercus and in private course materials.
:::
